import { Alert, AlertTitle, AlertDescription } from '@/components/ui/alert' import { Icon } from '@/components/ui/icon' /** A vertical stack of informational, success, and destructive alerts with icons. */ export function Alerts() { return (
Heads up Your trial ends in 3 days — upgrade to keep your projects. Changes saved Your profile has been updated successfully. Payment failed We couldn’t process your card. Update your billing details.

meta.use_when: You need to surface inline status messages of varying severity (info, success, destructive) within a page.
meta.not_for: the message is transient feedback about an action just taken — use a toast, not an inline alert → sonner; the message is site-wide and dismissible rather than local to a page section → announcement-banner; the "message" is really an empty view that needs an explanation and a call to action → empty-state

docs: A vertical stack of informational, success, and destructive alerts with icons. Do: Match severity to consequence: destructive for blocking errors, default for neutral information. Don't: Use destructive styling for emphasis on non-error messages. Use sonner when the message is transient feedback about an action just taken — use a toast, not an inline alert. Use announcement-banner when the message is site-wide and dismissible rather than local to a page section. Use empty-state when the "message" is really an empty view that needs an explanation and a call to action.
